label: miso 34 reserve coopt
definition: MISO 34 (PROBE, not keeper): energy+reserve co-opt ON (RBDC = MSSC + 400 MW regulating, $3500/MWh VOLL max penalty — MISO's real operating-reserve design). Reserve demand is NON-BINDING at 3-zone granularity: the ~1.7 GW market-wide requirement is trivially met by aggregate headroom, so it never forces commitment. CT_PEAKER stays inert (1.8/3.1/4.0 TWh, no forcing), ST_GAS flat (11.1/12.1/11.8), scarcity tail unchanged 0 h (max $61/$60/$73 vs actual 30/37/88 h). Price LEVEL lifted +2/+3/+4 $/MWh (legitimate reserve opportunity cost; C3a -14/-17% -> ~-8%), but coal 2025 REGRESSED to +18.7% (was +10.5% in miso-31) because reserve headroom pulled off gas is backfilled by coal. Diagnosis: the intended CT/ST-forcing + tail-lift needs sub-regional/zonal reserve zones with deliverability limits, NOT a market-wide curve at 3-zone copperplate and NOT a CC offer haircut. Next workstream: finer reserve-zone granularity.
